# arin_ticket_message (Data Source)

Read an existing ticket message and attachment references. Content is sensitive and stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
# This data source stores sensitive content in Terraform state.
data "arin_ticket_message" "example" {
  ticket_number = "20260922-X1"
  message_id    = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message_id` (Number, Sensitive) Existing message ID within the ticket.
- `ticket_number` (String, Sensitive) Existing ARIN ticket number. The API key must have access to the ticket.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_references` (Attributes List, Sensitive) attachment references returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachment_references))
- `attachments` (Attributes List, Sensitive) attachments returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments))
- `category` (String, Sensitive) category returned by ARIN.
- `created_date` (String, Sensitive) created date returned by ARIN.
- `subject` (String, Sensitive) subject returned by ARIN.
- `text` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered lines of text.

<a id="nestedatt--attachment_references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachment_references`

Read-Only:

- `attachment_id` (String, Sensitive) attachment id returned by ARIN.
- `filename` (String, Sensitive) filename returned by ARIN.


<a id="nestedatt--attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachments`

- `filename` (String, Sensitive) filename returned by ARIN.
